abstract: Medical large language models achieving high benchmark accuracy exhibit unexplained variability in clinical tasks, producing errors that clinicians cannot safeguard against. We evaluated clinical reasoning stability in GPT-5, MedGemma-27B-Text-IT, and OpenBioLLM-Llama3-70B using 3035 systematic perturbations from physician-validated oncology SOAP, brief vignette, and MIMIC cases. We trained sparse autoencoders on 1 billion tokens from 50,000 MIMIC-IV clinical notes to decompose their internal representation. We find models exhibit dramatic reasoning instability, shifting staging accuracy by over 50% based solely on prompt format, or generating definitive staging in clinically insufficient scenarios. Sparse autoencoder analysis revealed hierarchical encoding in MedGemma, where high-magnitude features encode lexical identity and low-magnitude features encode contextual meaning. OpenBioLLM distributes information uniformly. We demonstrate that these internal encoding structures differentially affect retrieval and reasoning interventions, suggesting interventions effective for one architecture may harm another. These results motivate architecture-specific safety validation as a component of pre-deployment evaluation for medical LLMs.

abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence (AI) often trades predictive performance against interpretability. This study develops an interpretability-driven feature engineering framework for multi-outcome risk stratification at hospitalization for chronic hepatitis B. A total of 36,024 hospitalization records from 22,001 patients were included. The framework integrating SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based main and interaction effects was used to construct compact machine learning models for classifying disease non-progression, liver cirrhosis (LC), and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). SHAP main effects selected the top 15 features per outcome; TreeSHAP interactions selected four pairwise terms. Performance was evaluated using patient-level data splitting, temporal validation, and independent external validation, with calibration and decision-curve analyses. The full-feature models achieved superior discrimination (AUCs: 0.927, 0.897, and 0.899) for classifying hospitalization-recorded disease non-progression, LC, and HCC, respectively. The corresponding compact models maintained strong discrimination (AUCs: 0.911, 0.882, and 0.890) with 80.8% fewer features. Interaction models yielded subtle AUC shifts (AUCs: 0.912, 0.881, and 0.891) while characterizing potential clinical joint-effect patterns. Temporal validation yielded AUCs of 0.863, 0.827, and 0.847, while external validation yielded AUCs of 0.829, 0.865, and 0.827, respectively. The framework produced compact and transparent models for contemporaneous risk stratification in clinical practice, seamlessly uniting predictive accuracy with multi-level interpretability.

abstract: Persistent fever after initiating intravenous antibiotics is common in hospitalized patients with cancer and often leads to additional imaging and antimicrobial escalation. Early identification of patients unlikely to remain febrile could provide additional information during clinical reassessment. We developed and externally validated machine learning models to predict persistent fever 48-72 h after antibiotic initiation using electronic health records from two academic hospitals. Adult cancer patients with fever within 24-48 h of treatment were included. Models incorporated demographics, comorbidities, laboratory results, vital signs, and temperature patterns. The best-performing model achieved an AUROC of 0.82 (95% CI 0.79-0.84) internally and 0.78 (95% CI 0.77-0.79) externally. Temperature-related variables were the dominant predictors. Decision curve analysis demonstrated positive net benefit across much of the evaluated threshold range. Retrospective assessment suggested that approximately one quarter of antibiotic escalations and chest CT scans occurred in patients correctly predicted not to remain febrile, highlighting the potential contextual value of fever predictions. These findings indicate that short-term fever persistence can be predicted with clinically meaningful accuracy using routine data. However, clinical use should be limited to an adjunctive role rather than standalone rule-out decision-making, and prospective studies are required to evaluate safety, clinician uptake, and real-world impact.

abstract: Generating clinical synthetic text represents an effective solution for common clinical NLP issues like sparsity and privacy. This paper aims to conduct a systematic review on generating synthetic medical free-text by formulating quantitative analysis to three research questions concerning (i) the purpose of generation, (ii) the techniques, and (iii) the evaluation methods. We searched PubMed, ScienceDirect, Web of Science, Scopus, IEEE, Google Scholar, and arXiv databases for publications associated with generating synthetic medical unstructured free-text. We have identified 94 relevant articles out of 1,398 collected ones. A great deal of attention has been given to the generation of synthetic medical text from 2018 onwards, where the main purpose of such a generation is towards text augmentation, assistive writing, corpus building, privacy-preserving, annotation, and usefulness. Transformer architectures were the main predominant technique used to generate the text, especially the GPTs. On the other hand, there were four main aspects of evaluation, including similarity, privacy, structure, and utility, where utility was the most frequent method used to assess the generated synthetic medical text. Although the generated synthetic medical text demonstrated a moderate possibility to act as real medical documents in different downstream NLP tasks, it has proven to be a great asset as augmented, complementary to the real documents, towards improving the accuracy and overcoming sparsity/undersampling issues. Yet, privacy is still a major issue behind generating synthetic medical text, where more human assessments are needed to check for the existence of any sensitive information. Despite that, advances in generating synthetic medical text will considerably accelerate the adoption of workflows and pipeline development, discarding the time-consuming legalities of data transfer.

abstract: [Annals of noninvasive electrocardiology : the official journal of the International Society for Holter and Noninvasive Electrocardiology, Inc] Left ventricular systolic dysfunction (LVSD) is common and treatable but often undiagnosed, especially in early stages with non-specific symptoms. AI applied to standard ECGs offers low-cost screening for low ejection fraction (EF), yet its real-world impact on diagnosis remains unclear. A systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs assessed AI-ECG screening for low EF in clinical practice. The protocol was registered with PROSPERO (CRD420261287652). Databases (PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Central, Google Scholar) were searched from inception to January 18, 2026, for RCTs comparing AI-ECG screening to usual care in adults without known heart failure undergoing routine ECGs. The primary outcome was new low EF (≤ 50%) confirmed by echocardiography. Secondary outcomes included echocardiography referral rates, positive predictive value, and cardiology referral rates. Pooled risk ratios (RR) with 95% CIs were calculated using a random-effects model. Three RCTs were included (two individual and one cluster) with 37,467 participants. After adjusting for clustering, AI-ECG screening significantly improved detection of new low EF diagnoses compared to usual care (RR 1.36, 95% CI 1.12 to 1.64; p = 0.002; I2 = 0%), with a number needed to screen of 204. No significant difference was found in echocardiography referral rates (RR 1.02, 95% CI 0.96 to 1.09; p = 0.55; I2 = 36%). The PPV of the AI tool ranged from approximately 20% to 34% across studies. AI-ECG screening added to routine care improves low EF detection without substantially increasing echocardiography referrals. These findings support AI-ECG for earlier LVSD detection in at-risk populations, though further validation across diverse AI platforms is warranted.

abstract: [Health affairs scholar] The healthcare industry is quickly adopting artificial intelligence (AI). Understanding Americans' views is essential in shaping how these tools are developed and implemented. The data presented here were derived from 16 national surveys of US adults extracted from the Roper Center iPoll database (January 1, 2022-June 24, 2026). This analysis reveals a significant equity issue: more than 4 in 10 Americans using AI for a health question did so, in part, because they could not access or afford care. It also reveals a gap between what Americans believe AI can do for the healthcare system and their trust in it for their care. Public concerns about AI are leading to legislative action at the state level, but this activity primarily focuses on oversight, accuracy, and privacy, not on the access gap driving AI use for many Americans.

abstract: Single-cell perturbation atlases now measure cellular responses across millions of cells, but the number of possible combinations of biological contexts, perturbations, doses and other experimental variables make exhaustive measurements infeasible. Here, we present GENESIS (Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator), a generative framework that predicts single-cell response distributions directly from the covariates defining an experimental condition. GENESIS uses a lightweight neural network trained with the energy score, a strictly proper scoring rule for distributions. We introduce an experiment-calibrated evaluation framework in which prediction error is interpreted relative to the reproducibility of repeated measurements of the same condition. Across the Tahoe-100M small-molecule atlas and a large PBMC cytokine atlas, GENESIS significantly outperforms existing generative models and statistical baselines and approaches experimental reproducibility on independently repeated conditions. Importantly, GENESIS remains accurate when trained on only a fraction of the available experimental conditions or cells, and generated profiles recover experimentally observed context-dependent transcriptional programs. At comparable training-cell budgets, GENESIS achieves more accurate predictions when measurements span more experimental conditions rather than profiling fewer conditions more deeply. Together, these findings suggest a complementary strategy for perturbation studies: broader, lower-depth measurements can expand experimental coverage, while GENESIS augments sparsely sampled populations and predicts responses in unmeasured conditions.
zh_abstract: 单细胞扰动图谱目前已能测量数百万个细胞的细胞反应，但生物学背景、扰动、剂量及其他实验变量的可能组合数量之多，使得穷尽式测量不可行。在此，我们提出 GENESIS（Generative ENErgy-based Single-cell Intervention Simulator，基于能量的生成式单细胞干预模拟器），这是一个直接根据定义实验条件的协变量预测单细胞反应分布的生成框架。GENESIS 使用一个轻量级神经网络，并以能量得分（energy score，一种针对分布的严格适当评分规则）进行训练。我们引入了一种经实验校准的评估框架，其中预测误差是相对于同一条件重复测量的可重复性来解释的。在 Tahoe-100M 小分子图谱和一个大型 PBMC 细胞因子图谱中，GENESIS 显著优于现有的生成模型和统计基线，并在独立重复的条件上接近实验可重复性。重要的是，即使仅使用一部分可用实验条件或细胞进行训练，GENESIS 仍保持准确，且生成的表达谱能够还原实验中观察到的依赖于背景的转录程序。在训练细胞预算相当的情况下，当测量覆盖更多实验条件而非对较少条件进行更深入的检测时，GENESIS 的预测更为准确。总之，这些发现提示了扰动研究的一种互补策略：范围更广、深度较低的测量可以扩大实验覆盖面，而 GENESIS 则可扩充采样稀疏的群体，并预测未测量条件下的反应。

abstract: Learning from large-scale bioactivity archives is complicated by heterogeneous assay readouts and differences in data reliability. Here we show that a model that predicts probability distributions over binding affinities from sequence data opens model training to vast and diverse troves of heterogeneous bioactivity data. We develop PSICHIC+, a bioactivity foundation model trained on approximately 82 million protein-ligand records using a distributional objective that preserves quantitative resolution while incorporating variation in data reliability. Given a protein sequence and ligand SMILES, PSICHIC+ predicts binding affinity in milliseconds. In zero-shot virtual-screening benchmarks without target-specific training data, it improves enrichment over regression- and classification-based approaches and performs competitively with leading structure-based methods. In lab-in-the-loop campaigns, distribution-guided acquisition improves recovery of high-activity compounds under fixed screening budgets. abstract: [Abdominal radiology (New York)] Ki-67 expression is a valuable prognostic indicator in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA). This study aimed to develop a non-invasive Deep learning (DL) model based on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and clinical data to predict Ki-67 expression preoperatively. Patients with iCCA between January 2020 and January 2024 were retrospectively reviewed. Based on immunohistochemistry, patients were classified into high-expression group (Ki-67 > 50%) and low-expression group (Ki-67 ≤ 50%). After image acquisition, tumor segmentation, and preprocessing, a 3D-ResNet10 network was utilized for MRI feature extraction. A feed-forward neural network (FFN) was used for clinical feature extraction. Subsequently, the extracted image and clinical features were fused and fed into a lightweight classifier to perform Ki-67 level prediction. The performance of the DL models was evaluated via 5-fold cross-validation using accuracy, precision, sensitivity, specificity, F1-score, and the area under the curve (AUC). A total of 117 patients were ultimately included (30 cases in the high-expression group and 87 cases in the low-expression group). The model based solely on clinical variables demonstrated limited predictive efficacy (mean AUC: 53.18 ± 14.60%). The model utilizing MRI features alone exhibited high specificity (86.14 ± 10.25%) but modest sensitivity. In contrast, the fused DL model significantly outperformed both individual models, attaining a mean AUC of 84.24 ± 8.82%, an accuracy of 87.17 ± 5.95%, a specificity of 93.07 ± 9.35%, and a markedly improved sensitivity of 70.00 ± 19.44%, yielding a robust F1-score of 73.42 ± 12.28%. We developed and validated a non-invasive DL model integrating contrast-enhanced MRI and clinical parameters that accurately predicts Ki-67 expression in iCCA, demonstrating superior diagnostic performance.

abstract: [Biomolecules & therapeutics] Animal behavior is a critical endpoint in preclinical pharmacology, toxicology, and therapeutic discovery, yet conventional behavioral scoring remains labor-intensive, low-dimensional, and difficult to reproduce across laboratories. Artificial intelligence (AI) can now quantify behavior from video with greater spatial, temporal, and phenotypic resolution. This review summarizes how object detection, markerless pose estimation, unsupervised behavioral segmentation, foundation models, and autonomous analysis agents are reshaping behavioral phenotyping. General-purpose object detectors rapidly localize and track animals, whereas open-source pose-estimation tools extend measurement beyond centroid tracking to body-part trajectories and fine motor patterns; paired with supervised classifiers, they have matched human scoring and exceeded some commercial systems. Technical accuracy alone does not establish behavioral construct validity or pharmacological validity. Unsupervised methods such as Motion Sequencing represent drug responses and disease-model phenotypes as structured changes in behavioral states rather than only as predefined endpoints, providing high-dimensional fingerprints of pharmacological action. Segmentation and tracking foundation models may reduce annotation burden but require validation across species, strain, sex, apparatus, and paradigm. AI agents may assist with literature review, code generation, analysis auditing, and figure production but must remain within transparent, human-supervised workflows. In behavioral pharmacology, pose estimation is established as a measurement method and emerging as a drug-effect endpoint, supervised classification and unsupervised segmentation are emerging, and foundation models and agents remain prospective. AI-enabled behavioral analysis can become a reproducible phenotyping layer for drug discovery and toxicology if researchers adopt open pipelines, rigorous validation, and reporting standards, rather than replacing one opaque measurement system with another.
zh_abstract: [生物分子与治疗学] 动物行为是临床前药理学、毒理学和治疗学研发中的关键终点，但传统的行为评分仍然费时费力、维度低，且难以在不同实验室间重现。人工智能（AI）现已能够以更高的空间、时间和表型分辨率从视频中量化行为。本综述总结了目标检测、无标记姿态估计、无监督行为分割、基础模型和自主分析智能体如何重塑行为表型分析。通用目标检测器可快速定位并追踪动物，而开源姿态估计工具则将测量从质心追踪扩展到身体部位轨迹和精细运动模式；与监督分类器配合使用时，它们已达到人工评分水平，并超过了部分商业系统。仅有技术上的准确性并不能确立行为结构效度或药理学效度。诸如运动序列分析（Motion Sequencing）等无监督方法，将药物反应和疾病模型表型表示为行为状态的结构化变化，而不仅仅是预先定义的终点，从而提供药理作用的高维特征谱。分割与追踪基础模型可能减轻标注负担，但需要在不同物种、品系、性别、实验装置和范式中进行验证。AI智能体可协助文献综述、代码生成、分析审核和图表制作，但必须处于透明、有人监督的工作流程之内。在行为药理学中，姿态估计已确立为一种测量方法，并正在成为药物效应终点；监督分类和无监督分割正在兴起，而基础模型和智能体仍属前瞻性。如果研究者采用开放的流程、严格的验证和报告标准，而不是以一种不透明的测量系统取代另一种，AI赋能的行为分析就能成为药物研发和毒理学中可重复的表型分析层。

abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] Electrocardiography is a widely available and low-cost cardiovascular test, and artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) can identify latent electrical phenotypes beyond conventional interpretation. However, high retrospective discrimination does not necessarily translate into clinically reliable or actionable benefit. This critical narrative review evaluates the translational maturity of AI-ECG across arrhythmias, acute myocardial infarction, heart failure, valvular heart disease, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, and cardiac amyloidosis. PubMed, IEEE Xplore, and Web of Science were searched from January 1, 2022, through July 10, 2026, with earlier landmark studies added by backward citation tracking. Seventy-seven publications informed the review. Evidence was appraised using five clinically oriented criteria: intended use, reference-standard reliability, external validation and transportability, clinical actionability, and effects on workflow or patient outcomes. AI-ECG has progressed furthest in ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction triage and reduced-left-ventricular-ejection-fraction screening, where prospective or randomized studies have demonstrated workflow or diagnostic-yield benefits, whereas acute myocardial infarction rule-out has reached prospective multicenter diagnostic validation. Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy screening has also advanced through international validation and prospective implementation. By contrast, occlusion myocardial infarction detection, prediction of occult or future atrial fibrillation, valvular heart disease, heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, long-term heart-failure prediction, and cardiac amyloidosis remain primarily validation-stage or risk-enrichment applications. Across domains, broader adoption is constrained by label quality, calibration, transportability, operating-threshold selection, and limited patient-outcome evidence. AI-ECG is therefore best positioned as clinician-supervised decision support linked to explicit downstream testing and care pathways.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in cardiovascular medicine] 心电图是一种广泛可及且成本低廉的心血管检查，而人工智能心电图（AI-ECG）能够识别常规解读之外的潜在电生理表型。然而，较高的回顾性判别性能并不一定转化为临床上可靠或可付诸行动的获益。本批判性叙述性综述评估了 AI-ECG 在心律失常、急性心肌梗死、心力衰竭、瓣膜性心脏病、肥厚型心肌病和心脏淀粉样变性中的转化成熟度。检索了 PubMed、IEEE Xplore 和 Web of Science，时间范围为 2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 7 月 10 日，并通过向前追溯引文的方式补充了更早的里程碑式研究。共有 77 篇文献纳入本综述。证据依据五项以临床为导向的标准进行评价：预期用途、参考标准的可靠性、外部验证与可迁移性、临床可操作性，以及对工作流程或患者结局的影响。AI-ECG 在 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死分诊和左心室射血分数降低筛查方面进展最快，前瞻性或随机研究已证实其在工作流程或诊断检出率方面的获益，而急性心肌梗死的排除诊断已达到前瞻性多中心诊断验证阶段。肥厚型心肌病筛查也通过国际验证和前瞻性实施取得进展。相比之下，闭塞性心肌梗死检测、隐匿性或未来心房颤动的预测、瓣膜性心脏病、射血分数保留的心力衰竭、心力衰竭的长期预测以及心脏淀粉样变性，仍主要处于验证阶段或风险富集应用阶段。在各个领域，更广泛的应用受到标签质量、校准、可迁移性、操作阈值选择以及患者结局证据有限的制约。因此，AI-ECG 最适合作为在临床医生监督下、与明确的后续检查和诊疗路径相衔接的决策支持工具。

abstract: [Personalized medicine] High-throughput technologies generate large and complex biological datasets that can challenge conventional methods of analysis and visualization. Artificial intelligence (AI) can support the analysis and integration of these datasets, provide new analytical approaches, and accelerate biological research. However, reliable AI applications depend on high-quality, consistent data. Technical errors, bias, and deficiencies in analytical methods can produce misleading findings and undermine reproducibility. AI-based approaches may help identify errors and improve data quality, but poor-quality or biased datasets, limited reproducibility, and concerns about privacy and ethics remain important barriers to their use in biological research. A literature search was performed in PubMed for papers published between 2015 and 2025. This review summarizes recent advances in AI for biological data analysis, including its main applications and potential benefits. It also discusses methodological, translational, and ethical challenges that may limit implementation. Particular attention is given to data quality and reliability, alongside the responsible use of AI in biological research and its translation to personalized medicine.

title: FateDriver: Weakly supervised dual-view graph learning for transition-specific prioritization of candidate regulators in cellular reprogramming

abstract: Cellular reprogramming supports regenerative medicine, yet the endogenous regulators of a specified source-to-target transition remain incompletely defined. Existing computational methods rank candidate regulators from network topology, trajectory dynamics, or cell-state labels, leaving unused the factors experimentally delivered to induce the transition. We present FateDriver, a weakly supervised dual-view graph neural network that jointly represents cells and genes from single-cell transcriptomes, treats the delivered factors as sparse gene-level labels, and ranks the remaining genes for a specified transition under a positive--unlabeled formulation. Across two OSKM datasets and one GMT dataset, FateDriver ranked first or second among six methods in recovering externally curated reference genes, exceeded a supervision-matched non-graph model despite weaker co-expression with the delivered factors, and achieved the highest recovery of protein targets of pluripotency-inducing chemical cocktails in both OSKM datasets. Holding either the source or the endpoint fixed yielded distinct candidate programs, including a DDX58--interferon axis associated with cells lacking endogenous pluripotency markers. Applying the same framework to candidate source--target pairs prioritized distinct candidate origins for two in vivo partially reprogrammed intestinal populations. FateDriver converts sparse experimental knowledge into transition-specific hypotheses for regulator prioritization from single-cell trajectories.
zh_abstract: 细胞重编程支持再生医学，但针对特定起始细胞到目标细胞转变的内源性调控因子仍未被完全阐明。现有计算方法基于网络拓扑、轨迹动力学或细胞状态标签对候选调控因子进行排序，而未利用实验中为诱导该转变所递送的因子。我们提出 FateDriver，一种弱监督的双视图图神经网络，可从单细胞转录组中联合表征细胞和基因，将所递送的因子视为稀疏的基因水平标签，并在正例-未标注（positive–unlabeled）框架下对特定转变中其余基因进行排序。在两个 OSKM 数据集和一个 GMT 数据集中，FateDriver 在恢复外部整理的参考基因方面，在六种方法中排名第一或第二；尽管与所递送因子的共表达较弱，其表现仍超过监督条件匹配的非图模型；并且在两个 OSKM 数据集中，其对诱导多能性的化学鸡尾酒蛋白靶点的恢复率最高。固定起始细胞或终点之一，可得到不同的候选程序，包括与缺乏内源性多能性标志物的细胞相关的 DDX58–干扰素轴。将同一框架应用于候选的起始–目标细胞对，为两个体内部分重编程的肠道细胞群体优先给出了不同的候选起源。FateDriver 将稀疏的实验知识转化为针对特定转变的假说，用于基于单细胞轨迹的调控因子优先排序。

abstract: RNA foundation models offer a promising route to decoding the relationships between RNA sequence, structure and function, yet how model shapes the acquisition and organization of biological information remains poorly understood. Here we introduce Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA (LIMBER), a hybrid foundation model integrating bidirectional self-attention with selective state-space modeling, pretrained on 40.5 million non-coding RNA sequences. Through task-specific fine-tuning, LIMBER achieves leading performance on secondary-structure prediction and non-coding RNA classification benchmarks, while demonstrating strong transferability to translation-related tasks and RNA--small-molecule interaction prediction. Beyond model development, we establish a unified, task-agnostic framework to systematically evaluate and interpret the biological knowledge intrinsically acquired by RNA foundation models. This framework validates LIMBER's strong capabilities in recovering RNA structures and predicting mutational effects, while uncovering a hierarchical, task-dependent organization of different biological information across model layers. By further systematically training and evaluating a broad panel of model variants spanning model capacity, training duration and dataset size, we uncover distinct scaling behaviors across structural, evolutionary and functional capabilities. Together, these findings establish LIMBER as a versatile RNA foundation model and provide broader insights into how architectural design, internal representations and scaling shape the learning of RNA sequence-structure-function relationships.
zh_abstract: RNA基础模型为解码RNA序列、结构与功能之间的关系提供了一条有前景的途径，然而模型如何塑造生物学信息的获取与组织方式，仍知之甚少。在此，我们提出 Layer-Interleaved Mamba-Bidirectional Encoder for RNA（LIMBER），这是一种将双向自注意力与选择性状态空间建模相结合的混合基础模型，在4050万条非编码RNA序列上进行了预训练。通过针对特定任务的微调，LIMBER 在二级结构预测和非编码RNA分类基准上取得了领先的性能，同时在翻译相关任务和RNA–小分子相互作用预测上表现出很强的可迁移性。除模型开发之外，我们还建立了一个统一的、与任务无关的框架，用于系统评估和解读RNA基础模型内在获得的生物学知识。该框架验证了 LIMBER 在还原RNA结构和预测突变效应方面的强大能力，同时揭示了不同生物学信息在模型各层之间呈现出层级性、依赖于任务的组织方式。通过进一步系统地训练和评估涵盖模型容量、训练时长和数据集规模的一系列模型变体，我们发现结构、进化和功能能力具有各不相同的缩放行为。总之，这些发现确立了 LIMBER 作为一种多功能RNA基础模型，并为架构设计、内部表征和缩放如何塑造RNA序列–结构–功能关系的学习提供了更广泛的见解。

abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] Brain imaging is central to the structural, functional, metabolic, and neurophysiological characterization of neurological disease, yet interpretation remains constrained by heterogeneity in acquisition, annotation, expertise, and clinical context. This systematic literature review evaluates recent artificial intelligence approaches for brain imaging and computer-aided diagnosis, with emphasis on methods, modalities, neurological diseases, diagnostic tasks, datasets, validation practices, and translational limitations. The review followed PRISMA 2020 and covered peer-reviewed English-language studies published from January 2020 through June 2026. Eight information sources were searched using database-specific terms for artificial intelligence, neuroimaging, neurological disease, and diagnostic analysis. The search identified 1,078 records; 236 duplicates were removed, 842 unique records were screened, 258 full texts were assessed, and 123 studies were included after a record-level eligibility re-audit. Heterogeneous evidence was synthesized narratively and by descriptive mapping rather than meta-analysis. MRI was frequently represented in the included studies and auxiliary mapping data; CT was commonly used in acute stroke and intracranial hemorrhage; PET supported selected molecular and differential-diagnosis studies; fMRI and diffusion imaging were used for network and white-matter analysis; and EEG extended the scope to neurophysiological diagnosis. CNN and three-dimensional networks were commonly reported, while attention, Transformer, graph, self-supervised, generative, multimodal, and foundation-model approaches appeared in selected recent studies. Stroke, dementia, and brain tumors were frequently represented, but heterogeneous populations, outcomes, and incomplete validation extraction precluded ranking diseases, modalities, architectures, or validation strategies. The evidence suggests movement from task-specific pattern recognition toward multimodal and context-rich decision support in selected settings, but it does not establish uniform methodological superiority or clinical maturity. Dependable translation requires patient-level data governance, transparent reporting, uncertainty estimation, independent multicenter testing, prospective workflow evaluation, and clinically meaningful endpoints.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in human neuroscience] 脑成像在神经系统疾病的结构、功能、代谢和神经生理学特征描述中处于核心地位，但其解读仍受到采集、标注、专业经验和临床背景异质性的制约。本系统文献综述评估了近期用于脑成像和计算机辅助诊断的人工智能方法，重点关注方法、模态、神经系统疾病、诊断任务、数据集、验证实践和转化局限。本综述遵循 PRISMA 2020，涵盖 2020 年 1 月至 2026 年 6 月发表的经同行评议的英文研究。使用针对各数据库的检索词（涉及人工智能、神经影像、神经系统疾病和诊断分析），检索了八个信息来源。检索共获得 1,078 条记录；去除 236 条重复记录，筛选 842 条唯一记录，评估 258 篇全文，在记录层面的纳入资格复核后最终纳入 123 项研究。异质性证据采用叙述性综合和描述性图谱的方式进行整合，而非荟萃分析。MRI 在纳入研究及辅助图谱数据中出现频率较高；CT 常用于急性卒中和颅内出血；PET 支持部分分子层面及鉴别诊断研究；fMRI 和扩散成像用于网络和白质分析；脑电图（EEG）则将范围扩展至神经生理学诊断。CNN 和三维网络被普遍报道，而注意力机制、Transformer、图、自监督、生成式、多模态和基础模型方法则出现在部分近期研究中。卒中、痴呆和脑肿瘤的出现频率较高，但由于人群、结局的异质性以及验证信息提取不完整，无法对疾病、模态、架构或验证策略进行排序。证据提示，在部分场景中，研究正从特定任务的模式识别转向多模态且富含情境信息的决策支持，但并不能确立统一的方法学优越性或临床成熟度。可靠的转化需要患者层面的数据治理、透明的报告、不确定性估计、独立的多中心检验、前瞻性工作流程评估以及具有临床意义的终点。

abstract: [Journal of visualized experiments : JoVE] Accurate preoperative templating for total knee arthroplasty (TKA) in patients with end-stage knee osteoarthritis (KOA) remains challenging, and the accuracy of conventional planning methods is variable. This preliminary, retrospective, single-center study evaluated the reliability of a robot-independent, artificial intelligence (AI)-based, three-dimensional (3D) preoperative planning system (AIKNEE) for predicting prosthesis size and component position in patients undergoing TKA for end-stage KOA. Twenty-eight knees from 24 patients with Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3-4 KOA were included. The primary outcome was the agreement between the planned and implanted prosthesis sizes. Secondary outcomes included correction of the coronal hip-knee-ankle (HKA) angle, improvement in Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS) knee scores, and early postoperative complications. The planned size matched the implanted size exactly in 53.57% of femoral components (15/28; 95% confidence interval [CI], 35.8%-70.5%) and 46.43% of tibial components (13/28; 95% CI, 29.5%-64.2%). Agreement within ±1 size was 85.71% for femoral components (24/28; 95% CI, 68.5%-94.3%) and 96.43% for tibial components (27/28; 95% CI, 82.3%-99.4%), giving an overall matching rate of 91.07% (51/56; 95% CI, 80.7%-96.1%). The postoperative HKA angle improved from 173.0° ± 3.9° to 178.2° ± 1.2° (P < 0.001), and the HSS score increased from 39.7 ± 2.2 preoperatively to 80.8 ± 1.3 at the 1-month follow-up (P < 0.001). No major early complications, including infection, dislocation, or deep venous thrombosis, were observed. Within this preliminary cohort, the AIKNEE system predicted prosthesis size with a reliability comparable to that reported for existing AI templating tools. Because the study was retrospective, single-arm, unblinded, and limited to 1 month of follow-up, these data characterize planning accuracy only and do not demonstrate clinical effectiveness; adequately powered, controlled studies with long-term follow-up are required.

abstract: [JMIR perioperative medicine] AI is increasingly being applied across the perioperative continuum. AI should be viewed as a technology that can reduce cognitive burden, collate fragmented data into clinically meaningful information, support decision-making, and extend precision education to clinicians and patients. This editorial accompanies the JMIR Perioperative Medicine webinar held in May 2026 and presents our perspectives-informed by our clinical experience-on where AI can assist perioperative clinicians and surgical patients, the evidence available today, what is still needed, and how clinicians can prepare to practice alongside AI tools. We consider opportunities in preoperative risk assessment and optimization; intraoperative intelligent decision support; emerging technologies, such as surgical digital twins; and postoperative recovery, monitoring, and prediction of clinical deterioration. Most AI applications remain early and require large-scale, prospective validation across diverse populations and resource settings. Realizing their potential also requires confronting substantial challenges, including limited and fragmented training data, the specialized models needed to interpret the large volumes of data captured in operative videos and during physiological monitoring, biases embedded in data and algorithms or biases inherent in human-AI interactions, and the determination of where human oversight is essential and where it is not feasible. When used responsibly, with human judgment remaining paramount, AI offers an unprecedented opportunity to advance perioperative care.
zh_abstract: [JMIR围手术期医学] 人工智能（AI）在围手术期全程的应用日益广泛。AI应被视为这样一种技术：它可以减轻认知负担，将零散的数据整合为具有临床意义的信息，支持决策，并将精准教育扩展至临床医生和患者。本社论配合2026年5月举办的JMIR Perioperative Medicine网络研讨会，基于我们的临床经验，阐述了我们的观点：AI可在哪些方面协助围手术期临床医生和手术患者、目前已有哪些证据、仍需要哪些证据，以及临床医生如何做好准备以与AI工具协同工作。我们探讨了以下方面的机遇：术前风险评估与优化；术中智能决策支持；手术数字孪生等新兴技术；以及术后康复、监测和临床恶化预测。大多数AI应用仍处于早期阶段，需要在不同人群和不同资源条件下开展大规模前瞻性验证。要实现其潜力，还必须应对诸多重大挑战，包括训练数据有限且分散、解读手术视频和生理监测所获海量数据所需的专用模型、数据和算法中固有的偏倚或人机交互中固有的偏倚，以及确定何处必须有人工监督、何处无法实现人工监督。若能负责任地使用，并始终以人的判断为首要，AI为推进围手术期医疗提供了前所未有的机遇。

abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Rapid microbial identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction are fundamental to precision diagnostics, effective infection control, and antimicrobial stewardship. Artificial intelligence-assisted spectral microbiology is increasingly being investigated to convert complex spectral and imaging data into rapid microbiological identification and antimicrobial resistance prediction outputs. This review critically examines the integration of AI with matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization time-of-flight mass spectrometry, Raman spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, ultraviolet-visible-near-infrared spectroscopy, hyperspectral imaging, and automated colony imaging for microbial identification, strain discrimination, and AMR prediction. This work focuses on spectral preprocessing, feature engineering, machine-learning architectures, interpretability, validation, and clinical translation. Emerging evidence shows substantial potential to accelerate diagnostics while improving analytical precision and scalability. Nevertheless, dataset heterogeneity, instrument-dependent variability, limited external validation, and insufficient model transparency continue to constrain real-world adoption. Future integration of multimodal spectral, genomic, and clinical data could deliver robust, explainable, and interoperable diagnostic systems. It may support precision microbiology and antimicrobial-resistance surveillance, provided standardized acquisition, external validation, quality control, and uncertainty-aware interpretation are in place.
zh_abstract: [诊断微生物学与传染病] 快速微生物鉴定和抗菌药物耐药性预测是精准诊断、有效感染控制和抗菌药物管理的基础。人工智能辅助的光谱微生物学正日益受到研究，旨在将复杂的光谱和成像数据转化为快速的微生物鉴定和抗菌药物耐药性预测结果。本综述批判性地审视了AI与基质辅助激光解吸电离飞行时间质谱、拉曼光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱、紫外-可见-近红外光谱、高光谱成像及自动化菌落成像相结合，用于微生物鉴定、菌株区分和耐药性（AMR）预测的情况。本文重点关注光谱预处理、特征工程、机器学习架构、可解释性、验证以及临床转化。新近证据显示，其在加速诊断的同时提高分析精度和可扩展性方面具有巨大潜力。然而，数据集异质性、仪器依赖性变异、外部验证有限以及模型透明度不足，仍制约其在真实世界中的应用。未来整合多模态光谱、基因组和临床数据，有望构建稳健、可解释且可互操作的诊断系统。只要具备标准化采集、外部验证、质量控制和考虑不确定性的解读，它就可能支持精准微生物学和抗菌药物耐药性监测。

abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA interactions (RRIs) play a vital role in cellular processes including gene regulation, RNA editing, and translational control. Aberrant RRIs are increasingly recognized as contributors to cancer initiation, progression, and metastasis. Accurate computational prediction of RRIs therefore offers significant opportunities for cancer biomarker discovery, understanding tumor biology, and therapeutic target identification. Among machine learning approaches, support vector machines (SVMs) have been applied in RRI prediction due to their robustness in handling high-dimensional, nonlinear data and relatively small training datasets. This chapter reviews SVM-based methods for RRI prediction, highlights representative tools and strategies, and discusses current challenges and relevance to cancer application. Emerging trends that integrate SVMs with deep learning and experimental data augmentation are also outlined, pointing toward pathways for clinical translation.
zh_abstract: [Methods in molecular biology (Clifton, N.J.)] RNA-RNA相互作用(RRI)在包括基因调控、RNA编辑和翻译调控在内的细胞过程中发挥重要作用。异常的RRI日益被认为与癌症的发生、进展和转移有关。因此,对RRI进行准确的计算预测,为癌症生物标志物发现、理解肿瘤生物学和识别治疗靶点提供了重要机遇。在机器学习方法中,支持向量机(SVM)因其在处理高维、非线性数据以及相对较小训练数据集方面的稳健性,已被应用于RRI预测。本章回顾了基于SVM的RRI预测方法,重点介绍了代表性工具和策略,并讨论了当前的挑战及其与癌症应用的相关性。本章还概述了将SVM与深度学习和实验数据增强相结合的新兴趋势,指出了通往临床转化的途径。

abstract: Traditional machine learning models trained on gut microbiome abundance profiles can distinguish individuals with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) from non-IBD individuals. However, their interpretation typically considers taxa in isolation, making it difficult to understand how associations between taxa contribute to predictions. Here, we inferred individual-specific microbial association networks from longitudinal metagenomics data of 106 individuals in HMP2/iHMP and used them to train and interpret graph neural network (GNN) models, which we compared with abundance-based models such as Random Forest (RF). Although RF achieved higher predictive performance (AUPRC ~0.59 vs 0.446), interpreting the GNNs revealed that their predictions relied on a densely connected module of co-abundant Bacteroidales species. Unlike the taxa prioritized by RF, these species were not differentially abundant between conditions. In an independent cohort, this module carried most of the predictive signal, and removing its associations reduced performance to near chance. These results show that coordinated association structure, rather than abundance shifts alone, is a feature of the IBD gut microbiome, and that interpreting GNNs can uncover such patterns that complement abundance-based analyses.
zh_abstract: 基于肠道微生物组丰度谱训练的传统机器学习模型可以区分炎症性肠病（IBD）患者与非 IBD 个体。然而，其解释通常孤立地考虑各个分类单元，难以理解分类单元之间的关联如何对预测产生贡献。在此，我们从 HMP2/iHMP 中 106 名个体的纵向宏基因组学数据推断出个体特异性的微生物关联网络，并用其训练和解释图神经网络（GNN）模型，同时将其与随机森林（RF）等基于丰度的模型进行比较。尽管 RF 取得了更高的预测性能（AUPRC 约 0.59 对 0.446），但对 GNN 的解释显示，其预测依赖于一个由共丰度的拟杆菌目（Bacteroidales）物种构成的紧密连接模块。与 RF 所优先选择的分类单元不同，这些物种在不同状态之间并无丰度差异。在一个独立队列中，该模块承载了大部分预测信号，去除其关联后性能降至接近随机水平。这些结果表明，协同的关联结构而不仅仅是丰度变化，是 IBD 肠道微生物组的一个特征，而对 GNN 的解释能够揭示此类模式，从而补充基于丰度的分析。

abstract: [Journal of clinical practice and research] Prostate cancer, one of the most common cancers affecting men's health worldwide, ranks second among cancer-related deaths. Therefore, it represents a critical health issue, and early diagnosis is crucial. Several imaging and analytical methods are used to diagnose this condition. This study focuses on research conducted between 2021 and 2025 that analyzes, diagnoses, and grades prostate cancer based on histopathological images using machine learning and deep learning algorithms. In this context, the reviewed studies also include an analysis of findings related to preprocessing and feature extraction methods that may aid in prostate cancer detection, as well as the classifiers used. According to the findings of the reviewed studies, artificial intelligence-supported prostate cancer detection systems demonstrate high clinical performance and significantly improve the diagnostic accuracy of pathologists by enabling rapid diagnosis. The presented research findings indicate a need for comprehensive studies focusing on prostate cancer using histopathological images. The integration of artificial intelligence is transforming prostate cancer pathology from a traditional and subjective process into a data-driven and standardized framework. This systematic analysis of histopathological images will make significant contributions to future prostate cancer research, help achieve more reliable results in clinical decision-making processes, and lay the groundwork for personalized medicine.
zh_abstract: [临床实践与研究杂志] 前列腺癌是影响全球男性健康的最常见癌症之一，在癌症相关死亡中位居第二。因此，它是一个关键的健康问题，早期诊断至关重要。目前有多种影像学和分析方法用于诊断该疾病。本研究聚焦于2021年至2025年间开展的、基于组织病理学图像并利用机器学习和深度学习算法对前列腺癌进行分析、诊断和分级的研究。在此背景下，所纳入综述的研究还包括对可能有助于前列腺癌检测的预处理和特征提取方法以及所用分类器相关发现的分析。根据所综述研究的结果，人工智能支持的前列腺癌检测系统表现出较高的临床性能，并可通过实现快速诊断显著提高病理医师的诊断准确性。所呈现的研究结果表明，需要开展以组织病理学图像为基础、聚焦前列腺癌的全面研究。人工智能的整合正在将前列腺癌病理学从传统且主观的过程转变为数据驱动的标准化框架。对组织病理学图像的这一系统性分析将为未来前列腺癌研究做出重要贡献，有助于在临床决策过程中获得更可靠的结果，并为个体化医疗奠定基础。

abstract: [Therapeutics and clinical risk management] Circulating biomarkers, particularly cell-free DNA (cfDNA), are transforming contemporary medicine through their capacity to provide dynamic, minimally invasive assessments of disease dynamics. Their clinical utility has broadened substantially to include oncology, cardiovascular conditions, transplant monitoring, infectious diseases, and persistent inflammatory disorders. Nevertheless, the increasing complexity and volume of biomarker-related data pose substantial challenges, necessitating the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning methodologies for improved data interpretation, risk assessment, and clinical decision-making. This review presents a thorough examination of recent progress in the integration of circulating biomarkers with AI within therapeutic contexts and clinical risk management. It outlines the translational trajectory from molecular signatures to precision medicine, addresses present constraints, and explores prospective developments. The objective of this review is to serve as a systematic resource for both clinical practice and research, thereby promoting the evolution of personalized medicine through innovative, biomarker-driven strategies supported by AI.
zh_abstract: [治疗与临床风险管理] 循环生物标志物，尤其是游离DNA（cfDNA），因其能够对疾病动态提供动态、微创的评估，正在改变当代医学。其临床应用已大幅扩展至肿瘤学、心血管疾病、移植监测、感染性疾病和持续性炎症性疾病。然而，生物标志物相关数据日益增长的复杂性和数量带来了重大挑战，需要整合人工智能（AI）和机器学习方法，以改进数据解读、风险评估和临床决策。本综述全面考察了在治疗情境和临床风险管理中循环生物标志物与AI整合的最新进展。文章概述了从分子特征到精准医学的转化路径，论述了目前的局限性，并探讨了未来的发展。本综述旨在为临床实践和研究提供系统性的参考资源，从而通过由AI支持的、以生物标志物为驱动的创新策略，推动个体化医学的发展。

abstract: [Talanta] Neurochemical sensing is central to understanding brain function, neurological disorders, and precision neurotherapeutics. Despite advances in electrochemical, optical, implantable, wearable, and genetically encoded technologies, current platforms remain limited by molecular selectivity, long-term stability, biofouling, complex data interpretation, and clinical translation. This review critically examines 83 representative studies encompassing nanomaterial-enabled electrochemical sensors, implantable and wearable devices, genetically encoded and CRISPR-engineered systems, AI-assisted analytical frameworks, and multimodal bioelectronic interfaces. Among the reviewed platforms, 68.7% were based on electrochemical or electrical sensing, whereas only 9.6% incorporated explicit AI/ML-assisted data analysis, indicating that intelligent analytical functionalities remain relatively limited. AI-assisted platforms have shown promising capabilities for signal discrimination, quantitative analysis, and enhanced analytical performance across diverse neurochemical sensing modalities, but their reported performance remains highly dependent on the sensing architecture, experimental conditions, and level of validation. Rather than providing a conventional technology-centered survey, this review establishes a unified framework for evaluating neurochemical sensing across five dimensions: molecular selectivity, spatiotemporal resolution, operational stability, intelligent data interpretation, and translational readiness. The reviewed evidence indicates a transition from conventional single-modality sensing toward integrated platforms incorporating multimodal detection and intelligent data interpretation, with adaptive and closed-loop interfacing emerging as future directions. By connecting advances in molecular recognition, functional materials, bioelectronics, and AI, this review identifies key design principles, persistent bottlenecks, and realistic priorities for translating next-generation neurochemical sensing platforms into reliable and clinically relevant intelligent interfaces.
zh_abstract: [Talanta] 神经化学传感对于理解脑功能、神经系统疾病和精准神经治疗至关重要。尽管电化学、光学、植入式、可穿戴和基因编码技术已取得进展，但现有平台仍受限于分子选择性、长期稳定性、生物污损、复杂的数据解读以及临床转化。本综述对 83 项具有代表性的研究进行了批判性审视，涵盖纳米材料赋能的电化学传感器、植入式和可穿戴设备、基因编码和 CRISPR 工程化系统、AI 辅助分析框架以及多模态生物电子接口。在所纳入综述的平台中，68.7% 基于电化学或电学传感，而仅有 9.6% 明确采用了 AI/ML 辅助的数据分析，表明智能分析功能仍相对有限。AI 辅助平台在多种神经化学传感模式中已显示出在信号区分、定量分析和提升分析性能方面的良好能力，但其报告的性能在很大程度上取决于传感架构、实验条件和验证水平。本综述并非提供传统以技术为中心的概述，而是建立了一个统一框架，从五个维度评估神经化学传感：分子选择性、时空分辨率、运行稳定性、智能数据解读和转化成熟度。已综述的证据表明，该领域正从传统的单模态传感向整合多模态检测与智能数据解读的集成平台转变，自适应和闭环接口正成为未来的发展方向。通过将分子识别、功能材料、生物电子学和 AI 方面的进展联系起来，本综述明确了关键设计原则、长期存在的瓶颈，以及将新一代神经化学传感平台转化为可靠且具有临床意义的智能接口的现实优先事项。
